D6E2.Settings.FirstEdition.Options.first: Attribute advancement cost multiplier
First Edition cost multiplier used when advancing an Attribute. The advancement service will consume this value.
Skill advancement cost multiplier
First Edition cost multiplier used when advancing a Skill.
Specialization advancement cost multiplier
First Edition cost multiplier used when advancing a Specialization.
Use Body Points
Select the OpenD6 Body Point health variant within the First Edition damage profile. Leave disabled for wound levels.
Character Points per Attribute roll
Maximum Character Points that may augment one Attribute roll.
Character Points per Skill roll
Maximum Character Points that may augment one Skill roll.
Character Points per Specialization roll
Maximum Character Points that may augment one Specialization roll.
Roll scale as dice
Use the OpenD6 dice-based scale option when the scale service is implemented.
Starting Attribute pips
First Edition character-creation Attribute allocation, stored canonically as pips.
Starting Character Points
Initial Character Point balance for newly created First Edition characters.
Starting Fate Points
Initial Fate Point balance for newly created First Edition characters.
Starting Move
Default First Edition Move value for character creation.
Starting Skill pips
First Edition character-creation Skill allocation, stored canonically as pips.
Metaphysics Attribute is optional
Support OpenD6 campaigns where Metaphysics is represented by Skills without displaying a separate Attribute.
Create Specializations in full dice
Use the OpenD6 full-die Specialization creation option instead of pip increments.
Track stun damage
Enable the OpenD6 stun-tracking variant inside the First Edition damage profile.
Wild Die one strategy
Choose the default OpenD6 response when the Wild Die rolls one.
